_doc: Bust art found bad while testing (user, 2026-11-11: 'keep track of bad bust art, so it can be re-queued'). One entry per bust: speaker (as in the dialogue), file (resource/bust/<key>/<emotion>.png), why, found (date/run), look (optional: what the new candidates must show - queue_busts.py puts it first in the prompt, weighted), seed_add (optional: another round with new seeds), fixed (set once a new pick is exported; --bad skips it). Requeue: python -E tools/queue_busts.py --bad [--only 'Speaker']  (new candidates for these speakers, even ones already in the game); then collect_busts.py, pick into _art/busts/npc_picks.json, `gen_busts.py npc <key>` (stage_export alone re-keys the OLD neutral.png), check the chin (CHIN_FIX) and magenta sheet (bustfringe.py <key>). Review sheets of the busts a playthrough showed: python -E tools/bustsheet.py story_N.
